title: 911 and 988 Outage Reporting Gate
tagline: A short outage can miss a volume threshold and still demand action because it touched a life-safety facility.

cards: A volume threshold makes the event look nonreportable.
911 or 988 impact changes both the clock and notification target.
A life-safety facility loses timely notice and regulator visibility.
Every reporting stage stays explicit and human-certified.

story.headline: The small outage that hits a 988 center
beats: A provider sees an outage well below the familiar user-minute threshold.
The affected route potentially serves a 988 special facility for more than thirty minutes.
The agent closes the event as too small to report.
The path classifier opens the special-facility clock and preserves both official notice and NORS evidence.
